chunks: Youth is a branch of madness.

key_terms.اَلشَّبَابُ: youth; the stage of early life marked by vigor and strong impulses
key_terms.اَلْجُنُونِ: madness; here, irrationality or lack of sound restraint
key_terms.شُعْبَةٌ: a branch or part; something that constitutes one aspect of a larger quality

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم mean by saying that youth is a branch of madness?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a concise ethical observation about youth, pointing to the impulsiveness and lack of restraint that can accompany that stage of life. It highlights a moral and psychological tendency, urging awareness, discipline, and sound judgment.
